learning_outcomes.text: Recognizes measuring instruments and measures different parts with available measuring instruments.
Recognizes manufacturing methods and the machines used in these methods.
Learns the method/methods required for the manufacturing of a part.
Knows the occupational safety and security rules to be followed in the workshop.
Knows the differences between manufacturing methods.
Gains practical experience in technical drawing and reading.
Applies the theoretical knowledge acquired in a workshop environment.
